name: dispute-resolution
description: Resolving a civil case in the general courts (oikeudenkäymiskaari 4/1734): drafting an application for a summons (haastehakemus), planning and assessing evidence, and appealing against a judgment (hovioikeus and leave for continued consideration, the Supreme Court and leave to appeal). Includes the fundamentals of alternative dispute resolution.
